title: 순수 JPA 리포지토리와 Querydsl

## 순수 JPA 리포지토리와 Querydsl --- > 📖
순수 JPA
[ 코드 ] Repository: MemberJpaRepository ```java package com.example.lectureprac.repository; import com.example.lectureprac.entity.Member; import com.querydsl.jpa.impl.JPAQueryFactory; import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager; import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository; import java.util.List; import java.util.Optional; @Repository public class MemberJpaRepository { private final EntityManager em; private final JPAQueryFactory queryFactory; public MemberJpaRepository(EntityManager em) { this.em = em; this.queryFactory = new JPAQueryFactory(em); } public void save(Member member) { em.persist(member); } public Optional findById(Long id) { Member findMember = em.find(Member.class, id); return Optional.ofNullable(findMember); } public List findAll() { return em.createQuery("SELECT m from Member m", Member.class) .getResultList(); } public List findByUsername(String username) { return em.createQuery("select m from Member m where m.username = :username", Member.class) .setParameter("username", username) .getResultList(); } } ```
[ 코드 ] 테스트 코드 ```java package com.example.lectureprac.repository; import com.example.lectureprac.entity.Member; import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired; import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import java.util.List; import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat; @SpringBootTest @Transactional class MemberJpaRepositoryTest { @Autowired EntityManager em; @Autowired MemberJpaRepository memberJpaRepository; @Test public void basicTest() { Member member = new Member("member1", 10); memberJpaRepository.save(member); Member findMember = memberJpaRepository.findById(member.getId()).get(); assertThat(findMember).isEqualTo(member); List result1 = memberJpaRepository.findAll(); assertThat(result1).containsExactly(member); List result2 = memberJpaRepository.findByUsername("member1"); assertThat(result2).containsExactly(member); } } ```
쿼리 확인 ```sql Hibernate: /* insert for com.example.lectureprac.entity.Member */insert into member (age, team_id, username) values (?, ?, ?) Hibernate: /* SELECT m from Member m */ select m1_0.id, m1_0.age, m1_0.team_id, m1_0.username from member m1_0 Hibernate: /* select m from Member m where m.username = :username */ select m1_0.id, m1_0.age, m1_0.team_id, m1_0.username from member m1_0 where m1_0.username=? ```
Querydls
Querydsl로 변경 - findAll() ```java public List findAll_Querydsl() { return queryFactory .selectFrom(member).fetch(); } ``` - findByUsername() ```java public List findByUsername_Querydsl(String username) { return queryFactory .selectFrom(member) .where(member.username.eq(username)) .fetch(); } ```
[ 코드 ] 테스트 코드 ```java @Test public void basicTest_Querydsl() { Member member = new Member("member1", 10); memberJpaRepository.save(member); List result1 = memberJpaRepository.findAll_Querydsl(); assertThat(result1).containsExactly(member); List result2 = memberJpaRepository.findByUsername_Querydsl("member1"); assertThat(result2).containsExactly(member); } ```
쿼리 확인 ```java Hibernate: /* insert for com.example.lectureprac.entity.Member */insert into member (age, team_id, username) values (?, ?, ?) Hibernate: /* select member1 from Member member1 */ select m1_0.id, m1_0.age, m1_0.team_id, m1_0.username from member m1_0 Hibernate: /* select member1 from Member member1 where member1.username = ?1 */ select m1_0.id, m1_0.age, m1_0.team_id, m1_0.username from member m1_0 where m1_0.username=? ```
--- - Querydsl은 기본적으로 조건(.where())에서 파라미터 바인딩 처리를 해준다. - 컴파일에서 문법 오류를 잡아준다. - JPQL은 런타임 시에 확인 가능하다.
JPAQueryFactory 의존성 주입 방법 > JPAQueryFactory 생성 시, EntityManager를 인자로 넣어줘야 한다.
1. JPAQueryFactory를 생성자에서 인스턴스를 생성 ```java @Repository public class MemberJpaRepository { private final EntityManager em; private final JPAQueryFactory queryFactory; public MemberJpaRepository(EntityManager em) { this.em = em; this.queryFactory = new JPAQueryFactory(em); } . . . ``` - 테스트 코드 작성 시, JPAQueryFactory를 주입하지 않아도 된다. - MemberJpaRepository 의존성 주입 시, 내부에서 인스턴스를 생성하기 때문에
JPAQueryFactory의 의존성을 따로 주입하지 않아도 된다. ```java @SpringBootTest @Transactional class MemberJpaRepositoryTest { @Autowired EntityManager em; @Autowired MemberJpaRepository memberJpaRepository; ```
2. bean으로 등록해서 주입해도 된다. - root 클래스에 bean 선언 - config로 따로 빼줘도 된다. ```java @SpringBootApplication public class LecturePracApplication { public static void main(String[] args) { SpringApplication.run(LecturePracApplication.class, args); } // 빈 등록 @Bean JPAQueryFactory jpaQueryFactory(EntityManager em) { return new JPAQueryFactory(em); } } ``` - 생성자 주입 ```java @Repository public class MemberJpaRepository { private final EntityManager em; private final JPAQueryFactory queryFactory; public MemberJpaRepository(EntityManager em, JPAQueryFactory queryFactory) { this.em = em; this.queryFactory = queryFactory; } . . . ``` - 테스트 코드 작성 시, JPAQueryFactory를 주입해야 된다..
🧐 위 처럼 사용 시, 멀티스레딩 환경에서의 동시성 문제가 발생되지 않는가? 엔티티 매니저가 스프링이랑 엮어서 쓰면 동시성 문제랑 전혀 관계없이 트랜잭션 단위로 다 따로따로 분리해서 동작한다. EntityManager 사용 시, 진짜 EntityManager가 아닌 프록시 객체인 가짜 객체를 주입한다. 따라서 멀티쓰레딩 환경에서 동시성문제를 걱정하지 않아도 된다.
- 자세한 내용은 자바 ORM 표준 JPA 책 13.1 트랜잭션 범위의 영속성 컨텍스트 참고
